title: RANDOMIZATION BOOSTS KV CACHING, LEARNING BALANCES QUERY LOAD: A JOINT PERSPECTIVE

problem_statement.en: Existing KV cache eviction policies like LRU are fragile under dynamic query arrivals, and current load balancing heuristics fail to capture the coupling between cache state and system congestion. This leads to suboptimal cache hit rates and increased end-to-end latency in multi-LLM serving environments.
problem_statement.zh: 現有 KV cache 淘汰策略（如 LRU）在動態 query 到達下表現脆弱，而現有的負載均衡啟發式方法無法捕捉 cache 狀態與系統壅塞之間的耦合關係，導致多 LLM 服務環境中 cache hit rate 欠佳、端到端 latency 上升。

key_innovation.en: A unified mathematical model for KV cache-aware load balancing, combined with a Randomized Leaf Token (RLT) eviction algorithm and a Learning-Based Greedy Routing (LBGR) strategy that uses online regression to predict end-to-end latency.
key_innovation.zh: 針對 KV cache 感知負載均衡建立統一數學模型，並結合隨機葉節點 token（RLT）淘汰演算法與 Learning-Based Greedy Routing（LBGR）策略，藉由線上迴歸預測端到端 latency。

key_improvements.en: Up to 6.92x higher cache hit rate, 11.96x reduction in median latency, 14.06x reduction in TTFT, and 77.4% increase in throughput.
key_improvements.zh: cache hit rate 最高提升 6.92x，中位數 latency 降低 11.96x，TTFT 降低 14.06x，throughput 提升 77.4%。

ai_task: LLM Serving, Multi-LLM Serving, KV Cache-aware Load Balancing
traffic_pattern: Poisson arrival process, Dynamic query arrivals, Batch processing
